answer.rationale: The primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, the incumbent has refused to reopen price, and finance demands an 18% cut. memory_c2 records that the low-cost vendor's onboarding was quick and invoicing accurate; memory_c6 shows volume pricing is achievable under multi-year terms. Together these indicate the low-cost vendor can meet the cost mandate alone while keeping delivery risk contained. Switching primary supply to the low-cost vendor is the only single action this cycle that satisfies both the cost mandate and the 14-day expiration without adding a new single point of failure beyond what already exists.
